summary: E2E verification of 4 review points on preview: (1) Persone tabs classification, (2) invite/activation → 'account_attivato', (3) VolunteerDashboard hides 'da_contattare' but renders operational OP_STATO badge, (4) /invito eye toggle + email FROM. Backend pytest 7/7 pass (1 skip is a superseded path — activation covered via a full E2E flow with token pulled from users collection). Frontend UI verified end-to-end with Playwright.

issues: Iubenda cookie banner overlays the bottom; pre-existing global concern, unrelated.

critical_code_review_comments: VolunteerDashboard.jsx OP_STATO map correctly OMITS 'da_contattare', so the commercial state never leaks into the member dashboard. Confirmed via real E2E: presence stato='da_contattare' → no badge; changing to 'confermato' → 'Confermato' badge with data-testid='vol-op-stato' appears.

persons-enriched flags is_referente/is_evento/is_staff/is_volontario compute correctly for the 4 seeded personas; Enrico Trambe appears exactly ONCE (no duplication) but classifies in BOTH 'Referenti aziende' and 'Staff & Volontari' tabs.
email_utils.send_email uses sender = 'CRMEvent <hello@crmevent.it>' (EMAIL_FROM_NAME/ADDRESS in backend/.env). No 'noreply' in code path.

Invite.jsx PwField renders type=password/text via useState + Eye/EyeOff icons and exposes data-testid `${testid}-toggle` — implementation is correct; UI could not be rendered live because no pending org_invite exists in preview (endpoint /api/invites/{token} for an invalid token shows the 'Invito non valido' error state, which is expected).

Persons.jsx tabs (tab-referenti-aziende, tab-staff-volontari, tab-da-classificare, tab-team, tab-turni, tab-tutte) and sub-filters (sv-sub-tutti/da_definire/staff/volontario) all present with data-testids and filter as expected.
